title: A repository never joins
subject: main
summary: A repository never joins — no exception, engine-built or hand-written. A cross-entity read is either a DB view or service enrichment: the service asks the other

adr.context: API8 as transcribed allowed AC-built queries to carry joins, and `membership.repository.ts` hand-writes a display-enrichment join over AC-admitted ids, its comment citing missing DSL view support (AC35). Daniel ruled the transcription wrong: a join sitting in a repository can silently bypass access control.
adr.decision: A repository never joins — no exception, engine-built or hand-written. A cross-entity read is either a DB view or service enrichment: the service asks the other entity's service for what is missing and merges.
consequences: **Contradicted by the code today:** the stage-2 enrichment join in `apps/main/slices/seed/user-organization-mgmt/api/repositories/membership.repository.ts` (user ⋈ userProfile ⋈ userContact) is a violation — extract to a DB view or service enrichment. To fix.
AC7 ("all joins come from the AC resolver/DSL... the repo only executes them") must be reconciled with this ruling when the access-control doc digests its rules.
The API8 claim in backend-composition was rewritten to state the rule flat.
